{{Quote|Move it, troopers, on the double! Fire!|Blitz leading three [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|Advanced Recon Force troopers]] to destroy the [[Trident-class assault ship/Legends|Trident drills]]|<ref name="ARC">{{TCW|ARC Troopers (episode)}}</ref>}}
'''Blitz''' was an [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Clone Commander/Legends|commander]] who was part of [[Rancor Battalion/Legends|Rancor Battalion]] and oversaw [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] training during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He wore experimental [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]].

==Biography==
Blitz was born on the [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], and was one of the millions of soldiers cloned from the DNA of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], who was hired by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]].<ref name="DB" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he was stationed on Kamino and oversaw [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] training with ARC [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Colt/Legends|Colt]] and several others, hoping to find future ARC [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]]. He later participated in the [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|defense of Kamino]], where he led three [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|Advanced Recon Force troopers]] to destroy the attacking [[Trident-class assault ship/Legends|Trident drills]]. Blitz and another [[Unidentified Advanced Recon Commando|ARC trooper]] were the only survivors of the few ARCs that participated in the battle, and he was seen doing what appeared to be clearing up damage in the battle's aftermath.<ref name="ARC" />

==Equipment==
Blitz wore experimental [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]] with yellow markings, a personalized white [[Kama/Legends|kama]] with black diamonds embroidered on its design, and a yellow dual [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldron]], along with a yellow [[Rangefinder/Legends|rangefinder]] on his helmet and a life support backpack. He also had a yellow stripe running downward on the left side of his helmet that followed through his breast plate.<ref name="CC" />
